func:
msg.topic = "AWS Service Status"; msg.from = "AWSMonitoringServices@riotinto.com"; msg.payload = `

Autonomous Water Stand (AWS) Service Alert

Dear Team,

Please be advised that ${msg.failure}.

This issue may require immediate attention to ensure the integrity of the AWS system. We kindly ask you to:

  • Investigate the cause of the failure.
  • Take appropriate action as soon as possible.

Thank you for your prompt response to this matter. For more information, please visit the dashboard.

AWS Monitoring Services
(This is an automated monitoring alert)
`; return msg;
